Name: Your own pet Mahoraga
Author: Altarios2
Description:
This mod is based on Mahoraga from popular manga/anime Jujutsu Kaisen, a divine general whom of which everyone knows is very friendly and approachable! This is [b]NOT[/b] a replacer and will stand as its own addition separate from any other pets you can purchase!

More features and animations will be added in the future so stay tuned!
